content.title: Alstom wins €1bn contract with NJ Transit for fleet modernisation
content.summary: The new order follows a prior acquisition of 174 Multilevel III vehicles from Alstom.

thumbnail.caption: The new Multilevel III cars will replace older single-level models that have been in service for 40 years. Credit: ALSTOM SA 2023

content.title: Alstom secures €538m contract for battery trains in New Zealand
content.summary: The trains will be manufactured at Alstom's Savli facility in India to replace the current diesel locomotive-hauled trains.

thumbnail.caption: Each train can carry up to 475 passengers and operate at speeds of up to 120kph. Credit: Alstom SA.

content.title: A Fresh Look at Alstom (ENXTPA:ALO) Valuation After Subtle Shift in Investor Sentiment
content.summary: Alstom (ENXTPA:ALO) is having one of those weeks where investors are left scratching their heads and debating what to do next. After a modest rise of 1.4% over the past day, there has been no clear trigger or blockbuster announcement. However, the move is enough to add the stock to many watchlists. Sometimes, all it takes is a small shift in sentiment or a glimmer of changing perception to get people talking. Taking a step back, Alstom’s journey over the past year has been anything but...

content.title: ERA grants approval for Alstom’s onboard ETCS for Traxx Universal Locomotives
content.summary: The approval enables operations in Austria, allowing ETCS-only operations on dual-equipped Class B lines.

content.title: Amtrak introduces NextGen Acela trains
content.summary: Amtrak aims to boost its Acela service capacity by 40% with the addition of 28 new trains.

thumbnail.caption: The NextGen Acela train is engineered to reach speeds of up to 160mph. Credit: Alstom SA.

content.title: Alstom secures contract for Mumbai Metro Line 4 in India
content.summary: New Metropolis metro cars will be manufactured at the Sri City facility in Andhra Pradesh.

thumbnail.caption: The design of the 39 trainsets will be conducted at Alstom's engineering centre in Bangalore. Credit: Alstom

content.title: Alstom secures £75m contract with GWR to reintroduce Class 175 trains
content.summary: The contract will see Alstom providing ongoing maintenance support from GWR’s Laira depot in Plymouth.

thumbnail.caption: The Class 175 trains will be the first in the GWR fleet to utilise Alstom’s HealthHub digital solution. Credit: Great Western Railway/Alstom.

content.title: Canadian government authorities approve single-source TTC subway contract with Alstom
content.summary: This decision comes as a strategic response to US tariffs and economic uncertainties, aiming to bolster Canadian employment.
